description: This file defines an internal interface 'ISiloMetadataSystemTarget' within the Orleans.Runtime.MembershipService.SiloMetadata namespace. The interface extends 'ISystemTarget' and declares a method 'GetSiloMetadata' that returns a Task of SiloMetadata, representing an asynchronous operation to retrieve silo metadata.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: An asynchronous method that retrieves the silo's metadata, returning a Task containing a SiloMetadata object.
